purpose: 用户要求首页更丰富好看；生成工作室主视觉与影视游戏入口插画

scenes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a beautiful hero illustration for a cute 3D film and game studio dashboard. Create a richly detailed miniature creative atelier diorama, wide landscape 3:2. Isometric dollhouse cutaway, an inviting curved cream studio on a floating pale pistachio platform with a large rounded arched window, warm afternoon sunlight, subtle paper-textured cream background. Three friendly adult chibi creative professionals collaborate around an organic desk with a tiny laptop, storyboard sheets, drawing tablet and game controller. Image 1 is the appearance reference for the black bob/silver streak woman in cream jacket. Image 2 is the appearance reference for the brown curly-haired woman in coral orange baseball jacket. Image 3 is appearance reference for the red-brown straight bob woman in lavender sweatshirt. Keep these three visibly distinct and in the same cute premium 3D animated style. Around them: a little cinema camera on tripod and softbox at one side, floating abstract geometric game landscape model and a tiny editing monitor at the other, a plant, warm wooden shelves with blank props, tiny coral and lilac accents, pale lime rug, miniature steps. Compose the scene as one coherent polished 3D collectible world, not a collage or UI. Focus on charming creative objects and lively spatial depth. Enough scene detail to reward a closer look but clean silhouette. Soft clay and satin materials, gentle contact shadows, warm ambient occlusion, beautiful sophisticated playful art direction. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or UI panels. No photorealism. No giant blank empty areas. This should feel like the actual magical headquarters of a film-and-game creative team.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: compact wide hero artwork for a film creation portal in a cute 3D creative studio app. Landscape 2:1. Premium miniature cinema set on a soft warm apricot peach background: an oversized charming dark plum 3D film camera with twin rounded reels on a small tripod, a striped pastel clapperboard with no writing, curled translucent amber film strip, three tiny cinematic spotlights with gentle beams, miniature golden sunset mountain scenery inside a softly glowing curved theatre portal. Composition mostly centered and fills the frame with a strong clean silhouette, objects crafted in smooth matte soft clay and polished colored resin, pale coral/peach/apricot with dark aubergine and warm butter yellow details. Sophisticated playful collectible diorama, rich dimensional studio lighting, tiny soft shadows, cinematic yet lovable. No humans, no text, letters, numbers, brands, watermark, labels or UI. Crisp attractive artwork that reads well in a small horizontal card.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: compact wide hero artwork for a game creation portal in a cute 3D creative studio app. Landscape 2:1. A whimsical miniature game world on a dreamy pale lilac background: an oversized cute cream and lavender game controller nestled beside a floating island with smooth turquoise grass, tiny mint paths leading through a lilac arched doorway, a small warm golden star collectible, rounded lilac and coral mushrooms, little translucent cube platforms at different heights. Curving magical path winds through the scene, suggesting exploration and play. Composition centered and filling frame, coherent premium collectible diorama in smooth matte soft clay and satin resin. Palette of lavender, periwinkle, mint and warm cream with one coral accent. Gentle dimensional lighting, subtle ambient occlusion and contact shadows. Charming, rich in detail yet clean silhouette, beautifully designed. No humans, no text, letters, numbers, brands, watermark, labels or UI. Crisp artwork that reads well in a small horizontal card.
